Chennamma Deve Gowda, wife of former PM, passes away

Chennamma Deve Gowda, wife of former Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda, has passed away. She was undergoing treatment for a respiratory ailment and died in Bengaluru. Her mortal remains were brought to Holenarasipur for the public to pay their last respects, and she was later cremated with state honours in Hassan.
